messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"book_code":"2ES","chapter":6,"verses":[{"verse":1,"text":"He said to me, “In the beginning, when the earth was made, before the portals of the world were fixed and before the gatherings of the winds blew,","chapter":6},{"verse":2,"text":"before the voices of the thunder sounded and before the flashes of the lightning shone, before the foundations of paradise were laid,","chapter":6},{"verse":3,"text":"before the fair flowers were seen, before the powers of the earthquake were established, before the innumerable army of angels were gathered together,","chapter":6},{"verse":4,"text":"before the heights of the air were lifted up, before the measures of the firmament were named, before the footstool of Zion was established,","chapter":6},{"verse":5,"text":"before the present years were reckoned, before the imaginations of those who now sin were estranged, and before they were sealed who have gathered faith for a treasure—","chapter":6},{"verse":6,"text":"then I considered these things, and they all were made through me alone, and not through another; just as by me also they will be ended, and not by another.”","chapter":6},{"verse":7,"text":"Then I answered, “What will be the dividing of the times? Or when will be the end of the first and the beginning of the age that follows?”","chapter":6},{"verse":8,"text":"He said to me, “From Abraham to Isaac, because Jacob and Esau were born to him, for Jacob’s hand held Esau’s heel from the beginning.","chapter":6},{"verse":9,"text":"For Esau is the end of this age, and Jacob is the beginning of the one that follows.","chapter":6},{"verse":10,"text":"The beginning of a man is his hand, and the end of a man is his heel. Seek nothing else between the heel and the hand, Esdras!”","chapter":6},{"verse":11,"text":"Then I answered, “O sovereign Lord, if I have found favor in your sight,","chapter":6},{"verse":12,"text":"I beg you, show your servant the end of your signs which you showed me part on a previous night.”","chapter":6},{"verse":13,"text":"So he answered, “Stand up upon your feet, and you will hear a mighty sounding voice.","chapter":6},{"verse":14,"text":"If the place you stand on is greatly moved","chapter":6},{"verse":15,"text":"when it speaks don’t be afraid, for the word is of the end, and the foundations of the earth will understand","chapter":6},{"verse":16,"text":"that the speech is about them. They will tremble and be moved, for they know that their end must be changed.”","chapter":6},{"verse":17,"text":"It happened that when I had heard it, I stood up on my feet, and listened, and, behold, there was a voice that spoke, and its sound was like the sound of many waters.","chapter":6},{"verse":18,"text":"It said, “Behold, the days come when I draw near to visit those who dwell upon the earth,","chapter":6},{"verse":19,"text":"and when I investigate those who have caused harm unjustly with their unrighteousness, and when the affliction of Zion is complete,","chapter":6},{"verse":20,"text":"and when the seal will be set on the age that is to pass away, then I will show these signs: the books will be opened before the firmament, and all will see together.","chapter":6}]}
